score_definitions.metrical: how strongly this row belongs to the primary/pulse grid
score_definitions.event: combined onset evidence from madmom, percussive onset, and bass onset
score_definitions.body: local loudness/body with small credit for rising energy
score_definitions.prominence: local relative strength among nearby pulse rows
score_definitions.contact: numeric plausibility that this row can carry a musical landing
score_definitions.support: numeric usefulness for quiet grid-aligned support/continuity
score_definitions.impact: suggested relative impact only if the row is selected as a contact
